newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Wing Tai buys hotel for S$380 million.
newsitem.headline: Wing Tai buys hotel for S$380 million.

text.p: Property group Wing Tai Holdings said that a subsidiary had on Thursday successfully tendered for the Cockpit Hotel for Singapore $380 million.
A company statement said its wholly owned subsidiary Wing Tai Land Pte Ltd has a 50 percent stake in Winpeak Investment Pte Ltd, which won the tender for the hotel.
Wing Tai did not say who owns the other 50 percent of Winpeak.
The Cockpit Hotel stands on a freehold site of 14,017.9 sq metres. A deposite of S$38 million will be paid on October 1 and the balance will be paid on completion of the sale and purchase agreement.
Wing Tai said the purchase will be financed by a combination of internal and external financing.
